prompt: Render the entire clip as a warm children's storybook illustration with pastel watercolor washes, delicate hand-drawn outlines, colored-pencil shading and subtle paper grain. Preserve the composition: a long dark-haired woman in a white blazer stands cropped at the left; a light-haired man in a blue striped shirt sits center-right, looking down and writing with his right hand. Her upper hand rests on his shoulder and her other index finger points at the writing area. Keep his writing tool recognizably a slim black ink pen, with a smooth barrel, visible pocket clip and narrow writing tip. Beneath his writing hand, retain a small landscape-format white notebook: a single stacked pad with dense spiral loops along the camera-facing edge and visible page thickness. A separate pale beige loose sheet lies immediately to its right, with its own outline and a clear boundary from the notebook. His left hand steadies the notebook's right edge. Keep both paper objects flat on the tabletop. Preserve the room layout, framing and existing gentle movements throughout.

style: Soft pencil outlines and paper texture
preserve: Two original people and their positions
Man writing with pen and notebook
Woman beside him and original shoulder contact

evaluation_note: Short prompts are evaluated on overall named style plus preservation; detailed style cues are descriptive and are not all mandatory for short prompts. Intended glitch/VHS/illustration changes are not generic artifacts. Ball visibility may be unjudgeable.
user_requirement: Make it look like a children's storybook.

planner.prompt: Render the entire clip as a warm children's storybook illustration with pastel watercolor washes, delicate hand-drawn outlines, colored-pencil shading and subtle paper grain. Preserve the composition: a long dark-haired woman in a white blazer stands cropped at the left; a light-haired man in a blue striped shirt sits center-right, looking down and writing with his right hand. Her upper hand rests on his shoulder and her other index finger points at the writing area. Keep his writing tool recognizably a slim black ink pen, with a smooth barrel, visible pocket clip and narrow writing tip. Beneath his writing hand, retain a small landscape-format white notebook: a single stacked pad with dense spiral loops along the camera-facing edge and visible page thickness. A separate pale beige loose sheet lies immediately to its right, with its own outline and a clear boundary from the notebook. His left hand steadies the notebook's right edge. Keep both paper objects flat on the tabletop. Preserve the room layout, framing and existing gentle movements throughout.
planner.rationale: 原片保有关键物件细节，可直接完成绘本化；重点明确黑色笔的形态和纸本结构，防止再次变成铅笔及对开本。
repair_targets: 保留黑色墨水笔的笔夹、光滑笔杆和细笔尖
保留近侧线圈与叠页厚度，并明确右侧米色散纸的独立边界
preserve_targets: 柔和水彩、彩铅排线与纸纹构成的儿童绘本风格
两人的身份特征、服装、左右位置及取景
男子右手书写、左手扶本的关系
女子搭肩及指向书写区域的互动
纸本平放桌面及现有运动趋势
recovery_limitations: 原片提供物件形态依据，但绘本化仍可能简化细小笔夹和线圈。
抽样无法可靠判断连续笔画和细微接触时序，本轮不据此调整动作。

style_match.label: clear
style_match.evidence: 全部候选样本均呈现柔和浅色、手绘轮廓、彩铅排线和纸面纹理，人物经过插画化简化，儿童绘本风格清楚。

edits.label: done
edits.evidence: 人物、衣物、桌面和背景均统一转为柔和彩铅插画，具有可辨认的儿童故事书观感。

preservation.item: 原来的两个人及各自身份特征（允许绘本化简化）
preservation.label: kept
preservation.evidence: 男子的浅色卷发、蓝色条纹衬衫，以及女子的深色长发、白色外套均保留；面部和发丝变化符合绘本化简化。

preservation.label: kept
preservation.evidence: 女子仍站在画面左侧，男子仍坐在中右侧并低头面向桌上的书写区域。

preservation.item: 男子继续进行书写动作
preservation.label: kept
preservation.evidence: 各样本中男子均右手握笔、笔尖朝向纸页，手和笔有小幅位置变化，保留了低头书写的姿态与动作趋势。

preservation.item: 书写工具的类别与可辨认形态
preservation.label: changed
preservation.evidence: 原片是带笔夹的黑色笔；候选变为黄褐色杆、削尖端的铅笔状工具，原笔夹和笔杆形态未保留。

preservation.item: 笔记本的装订和页本结构
preservation.label: changed
preservation.evidence: 原片小型笔记本的近侧边缘可见密集螺旋圈与叠页厚度；候选呈左右展开的纸页及中央接缝式外观，原有近侧螺旋装订结构消失。

preservation.item: 独立纸张与笔记本仍是两个可区分对象
preservation.label: partial
preservation.evidence: 候选右侧仍有另一块带轮廓的白色纸面，但它与左侧书写面紧密相接，容易读成同一本子的右页；原片独立米色散纸与线圈本的区别更明确。

preservation.item: 女子与男子肩部的接触关系
preservation.label: kept
preservation.evidence: 女子上方的手仍位于男子画面左侧肩部，指尖与蓝色肩部轮廓相接或重叠，搭肩关系可辨。

preservation.item: 手、纸本和桌面的空间关系
preservation.label: kept
preservation.evidence: 男子右手握笔位于书写面上方，另一只手扶在纸本右侧；女子下方的手仍指向左侧书写区域，纸本平放于桌面。

preservation.item: 镜头取景与可见的运动趋势
preservation.label: kept
preservation.evidence: 候选保持相近的固定近景和女子头部出框的取景，男子低头、书写手及女子指页手的小幅变化与原片大致对应。

candidate.summary: 儿童绘本风格已清楚实现，人物、位置和基本互动得到保留。书写工具呈铅笔化，笔记本装订结构改变，独立散纸的辨识度减弱。

next_focus.item: 书写工具的类别与可辨认形态
next_focus.visible_problem: 黑色带笔夹的笔被改画为黄褐色铅笔状工具。
next_focus.desired_visible_state: 在绘本画法中保留原笔的笔夹、笔杆和笔尖特征，使其仍清楚呈现原来的笔类别。

next_focus.item: 笔记本的装订和页本结构
next_focus.visible_problem: 原本近侧可见的螺旋圈和叠页结构被展开纸页、中央接缝式外观替代。
next_focus.desired_visible_state: 恢复小型横向线圈本的页本形态，近侧清楚可见螺旋装订和纸页厚度。

next_focus.item: 独立纸张与笔记本仍是两个可区分对象
next_focus.visible_problem: 右侧纸面与书写本紧邻相接，容易被理解为同一本子的另一页。
next_focus.desired_visible_state: 右侧散纸具有独立外轮廓和明确的分离或遮挡边界，与线圈本保持两个对象的关系。

temporal_limitations: evidence_frame_indices 按每组12张对齐样本从0计数；样本覆盖0至5秒，相邻间隔约0.45至0.5秒。
抽样支持判断可见姿态和大致变化；连续笔画、笔尖接触时序、细微手指运动及样本之间的稳定性无法可靠判断。

system_prompt: You are a helpful assistant specialized in video editing.
